reply_text:
I sent Pree her list in our DM. I found three Marrow Fieldworks ticket numbers, and only one of them is named as Marrow Fieldworks outright.

1. PD-5302 comes from #central-random. On 14 Oct Hollis posted it as a Marrow Fieldworks follow-up from this week.
2. #4409 comes from Moss's note "Central handoffs next week" (2 Jan 2026). It's a recurring timeout on the gatehouse check-in report at the Salina North yard.
3. #4412 comes from the same note. It's a glitch in the text prompts drivers get when staging combine trailers on unpaved overflow lots.

The note doesn't actually name Marrow Fieldworks next to #4409 and #4412. It lists them under the Marrow Fieldworks handoff as tickets on "Pree's dealer account", so I told her I'm treating them as Marrow Fieldworks.

I gave her two more things to watch:
- #8841 might belong to the same account, but I left it off the list. Tobias flagged it in #central-random on 13 Oct, and Hollis called it "Tobias's dealer account". Marrow Fieldworks changed hands in January, so it could be the same account, but nothing says so.
- FR-882 and PD-4821 belong to Marrow Agrisupply, a different account, so she shouldn't mix them up.

I only read channels she's a member of and public files, and I didn't use the company-wide message search. This week's messages in #central-team, #general, #help-it-ops and #inc-tansley-carrier-api had no other Marrow Fieldworks tickets. There are no ticket files in the shared files she can see, so I couldn't check any of these against the account's own records.
